items.title: Nike's Extra $5 Billion Still Leaves Sales Below 2024
items.summary: Nike stock fell 6.3% on Tuesday and closed at $35.85. The S&P 500 slipped 1.0% the same day. So Nike did 5.3 percentage points worse than the market. The drop came on the day Nike held its first investor day in nine years.

items.title: Revenue Decline Outlook Might Change The Case For Investing In Nike Stock (NKE)
items.summary: Nike used its November 2026 investor day to reaffirm fiscal 2027 guidance for a high single digit revenue decline and to signal that operating income will fall faster than sales as the business resets product, pricing and distribution.
